title: Hybrid search and reciprocal rank fusion
summary: Combine keyword and vector results and merge rankings with RRF for the best of both.

items: Merge rankings with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF).
Choose full-text vs vector vs hybrid.

blocks.body: Neither keyword nor vector search alone is best; hybrid + RRF fuses their strengths.

terms.definition: A method that merges multiple ranked lists using 1/(k + rank).

blocks.body: Run **full-text** and **vector** searches, then fuse with **RRF**: each document's score is the sum over lists of `1/(k + rank)`. RRF needs no score calibration between systems, making it robust. Choose full-text for exact terms, vector for meaning, and **hybrid** when you need both.

items.mistake: Averaging raw scores from different systems.
items.fix: Scores aren't comparable; use rank-based RRF instead.

tips: RRF fuses ranked lists without needing comparable scores.

blocks.body: Fuse full-text and vector results with RRF (1/(k+rank)) to get precise and semantic matches together.
